Methods: 'All specimens are preserved in 75% ethanol and examined, illustrated, photographed, and measured using a Leica M205A' + 'stereomicroscope equipped with a drawing tube, a Leica DFC450 Camera, and LAS v. 4.6 software.'; 'Eye sizes were measured as the maximum dorsal diameter.'; 'All measurements are in millimetres.'; 'Specimens examined here are deposited in the Collection of Spiders, School of Life Sciences, Southwest University, Chongqing, China (SWUC).'
